chapter: Mambo, the Palladium and Cubop City
title: Naming "Cubop City" and who arranged it
summary: Teddy Reig and Symphony Sid asked for a new "Tanga"; Mario titled it and Rene Hernandez arranged it, with McGhee and Moore filling in.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Okay, but that's another version of 'Tanga'.
The reason why you did it is because you already had recorded 'Tanga' for Verve, right? Who asked you to record 'Cubop City' or asked you to do it again, was it Morris Levy or Teddy Reig?
Symphony Sid. They asked and they gave it the title. Who gave it the title 'Cubop City'?
Mario gave it 'Cubop City.' Okay. Was Howard McGhee in on the arrangement or was that just made up on the spur of the moment?
No, no, he wasn't in the arrangement. The arrangement was made by Rene Hernandez .....
I see, and they filled-in very well.
Very well, very well. Well, they are two professionals.
